GrommeyUI
A clean modern allinone interface for The Lord of the Rings Online: flat opaque frames one accent colour and everything can be set and moved where you want.

Features

Bags: all your bags in one window sorted by category with your own categories search new items money and currencies.
Unit frames: player target target of target and party frames replacing the game ones with buffs and debuffs. Click a frame to target.
Info bar: money currencies bag slots durability FPS time session time and money...

HEALTH & POWER

Health & Power will help you visualize your resources in the style of an Action RolePlaying Game ARPG.

This plugin is designed and handdrawn to try to keep a cohesive subtle and visually attractive UI experience. As a beta version it is limited to having only the essential elements and key features.

Minor UI updates
New options menu window.

Outfit Snapper

Outfit Snapper is a cosmetic outfit snapshot and reference manager for The Lord of the Rings Online.

It lets you capture the contents of LOTROs Character Outfit panel into named Snaps save them for later organize them with tags search your collection inspect the gear used by an outfit and quickly reconstruct saved looks.
